syncIcon_fullContentLoop.description: Error detail shown when the server responds needsFullContent a second time in the same sync attempt, after a full-content resend

syncIcon_autoSyncDisabled.description: Note shown in the sync icon menu's `disabled` state, when the current platform is excluded from autoSyncPlatforms
